Life problems, solved

Wannes Cappelle's life is one long chain of problems. And before you take any pleasure in his misfortune: yours is no better. That can be quite discouraging. And understandably so. But if having problems is completely normal, then what exactly is the problem? There. Wannes has already unraveled that particular mystery. And that is just the beginning. He will personally tackle even more pressing and delicate questions for you. He does so by talking and singing. With a smile. Or with a sigh. But there is one thing you should understand: after seeing this performance, your life will never be the same again.
